question: What is said after those distinctions?
premises: after that in these śiva-rudra distinctions enough
on māyīya path established by śivas said named śiva
inference: After those distinctions, on the māyīya path, the one named Śiva is said by the Śivas.
plain_english: After that, in these Śiva-Rudra distinctions, enough; on the māyīya path, established by the Śivas, the one named Śiva is said.
